about: Expected present_output documents for real requests. "says" is the one sentence that ends the turn after the present_output call; the app decides where it appears. "fresh" says whether the data is time-sensitive. Dates are relative to reference_date. Figures, places, links and ids are illustrative: artifact, routine and Work Unit ids are placeholders in the uuid7 shape. Each example is validated against the copied contract schema and the playbook laws by scripts/check-output-playbook.mjs.

examples.request: What can I make for dinner with eggs, tomatoes and leftover rice?
examples.says: Fried rice, and the day-old rice is exactly what it wants.
examples.rationale: Built from what they have: time and servings as numbers, then ingredients and numbered steps; the pantry basics it assumes are in Details.

sections.heading: Ingredients
bullets: 3 eggs, beaten with a pinch of salt
2 ripe tomatoes, cut in wedges
2 cups cooked rice, a day old if you have it
2 spring onions, sliced, if you have them
1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tbsp oil

sections.heading: Method
paragraphs: 1. Scramble the eggs in the hot oil until just set, then tip them out.
2. Fry the tomatoes for 3 minutes until they soften and give up their juice.
3. Add the rice and soy sauce, press out any lumps and fry for 4 minutes.
4. Fold the eggs back in and finish with the spring onions.

assumptions: Uses what you listed plus oil, salt and soy sauce; the spring onions are optional.
